report.summary: All three failures are one flaky cause, not three bugs: `list_books` in app/main.py:150 sleeps for a random 0–8 seconds on every /books render, and the UI tests give up after 5 s, so whether a test fails depends on the random draw. Fix the app first by removing that random sleep (or making it deterministic and under the test timeout), then rerun the UI suite to confirm.

causes.title: Random 0–8 s sleep in list_books makes every /books render race the 5 s Playwright timeout
causes.explanation: list_books calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database (app/main.py:149-150). render_books calls list_books for every server-rendered /books page (app/main.py:256), and the register and delete flows redirect to /books. Whenever the draw exceeds about 5 s, the browser action times out. The test fixture sets the default timeout to 5000 ms (tests/ui/conftest.py:5-7). The three failures hit three different waits, all on that path: test_book_created_through_api_shows_in_ui fails in page.goto('/books') waiting for 'load'; test_deleted_book_disappears fails in Locator.click on delete-book, 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish' (the delete redirects to /books); test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf fails in Locator.click on submit, 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish' (register redirects to /books). The randomness is in the app, so the tests that wait on it are flaky. Other tests that load /books in the same suite pass on the same code, which fits a random delay. The API list endpoint shares list_books, so it is also affected.
evidence: app/main.py:297 / 336 / 346: register, add and delete all return RedirectResponse("/books", status_code=303)
tests/ui/conftest.py:5-7: page.set_default_timeout(5000) with docstring 'Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s'
Failure 1: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:51139/books", waiting until "load"
Failure 2: Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded ... click action done / waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (delete-book)
Failure 3: Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded ... click action done / waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (submit on /register)
tests/ui/test_login_ui.py:18: test_existing_user_can_log_in also loads /books and is not in the failure list, consistent with a random delay
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) from list_books in app/main.py. If the latency is meant to simulate a slow backend, make it a fixed, configurable delay that is off by default (e.g. an env var read in the app), and keep it well below the UI timeout. Do not raise the 5 s timeout to hide it. Then rerun the UI suite several times to confirm the failures no longer occur. Whoever added this sleep should confirm the intent, because the code does not say why it is there.
